verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data connectivity and aggregation platform (APIs, Connect Widget, webhooks). It is not an agent or MCP host, so letting users plug in external MCP servers for it to call is a category error for this kind of product. The documented MCP server (mx-probe-3) is a server-side capability and does not count toward this client-side story, and nothing in the evidence shows MX consuming external MCP tools.
